greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNyana, nelikaMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo lweNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu kunye nani nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, usivele imfesane. Kristu, usivele imfesane. Nkosi, usivele imfesane.
psalm_response: Makabongwe uYehova, uThixo kaSirayeli; uze kubantu bakhe.
homily:
Cinga ngomzuzu xa uBenjamin Vo, esesemncinci, ekhangela phezulu esibhakabhakeni ngamehlo agcwele umdla. Wayengumfana owayethanda iindiza—hayi nje ngenxa yobuchwephesha bazo, kodwa ngenxa yokuba zazimelela inkululeko kunye namaphupha angapheliyo. Wayehlala emi ecaleni kukatata wakhe, bejonga iindiza zinyuka, besithi 'con chim airlines' iya kubhabha kude. Loo mzuzu wokujonga phezulu, loo mzuzu wokulinda into eyayo, ngumfanekiso wethu namhlanje. KwiVangeli, uYesu usixelela ibali lomhlobo oya kunkqonkqoza phakathi kobusuku. 'Nkqonkqoza, uya kuvulelwa,' utsho uYesu. Kodwa kutheni sifanele kunkqonkqoza xa intliziyo yethu idiniwe, xa iingcango zibonakala zivaliwe ngenxa yentlungu?

KwiNcwadi kaGalati, uPawulos ubhala ngomsindo nangokudideka. Uthi: 'O Galati abaziziyatha! Ngubani unikwe ubungqina obucacileyo bukaYesu Kristu obetshwe emnqamlezweni?' Uthi abantu bayazikhohlisa ngokucinga ukuba banokufumana uMoya ngemisebenzi yomthetho. Uthi uMoya ufumaneka ngokholo. Kwaye apha, kule nyaniso, kukho ukukhanya okukhulu kuAlan, kuThao, nakuni nonke abaswelekelwe. Sihlala sifuna 'ukwenza'—sifuna ukwenza izinto ezininzi ukuze sizive sikhuselekile, ukuze sizame ukulungisa izinto ezingenakulingiswa. Kodwa uPawulos usikhumbuza ukuba ubomi abuxhomekekanga kwizinto esizenzayo, kodwa kwinto uThixo ayenzayo kuthi. UBen wayeyazi le nto ngendlela yobuntwana bakhe. Wayengumfana owayenika ngaphandle kokubala, owayenika ngaphandle kokuzama ukuthenga uthando okanye ukhuseleko. Wayenika kuba wayengumntwana kaThixo.

Ndiyazi ukuba kule nyanga yesithathu emva kokuba uBen ebuyele kuThixo, kukho imibuzo engapheliyo. Kukho iintlungu ezihlaselayo xa ungazilindelanga. Mhlawumbi ucinga ngaloo mzuzu xa wayemi phambi kwekhompyutha yakhe, ebhala iikhowudi zokudala umdlalo wakhe, okanye xa wayecinga ngendlela i-'con chim airlines' yakhe eya kubhabha ngayo. Loo ntliziyo yayicocekile, yayingenabuxoki. Kwaye namhlanje, ndifuna ukuthetha inyaniso enzulu kakhulu: akukho nqaku lokuthi uphosile okanye wenze kakubi. Ukugula akwanga kwenzeka ngenxa yezinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye noBen akakubeki icala. Masikhuphe lo mthwalo wokuzisola emajukujukwini eentliziyo zenu namhlanje. Awuphosanga nto. Ubenze konke okusemandleni enu ngothando olungapheliyo. Ezinye izinto zenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lwethu, ngaphandle kokuba nabani na enze impazamo. Niyinyaniso, nithandwa nguThixo.

KwiVangeli, uYesu uthi: 'Ngubani utata phakathi kwenu onganika unyana wakhe inyoka xa ecela intlanzi?' UYesu uyazi ukuba intliziyo yomzali iyahlaba xa isiva intlungu yomntwana wayo. UYesu uyazi ukuba ufuna ukunika uBen konke okuhle. Kodwa ngoku, uBen usebukhoneni bukaThixo. Uphumla apho kungekho nyembezi. UYesu akasiphi inyoka; usipha uMoya oyiNgcwele. UMoya oyiNgcwele nguye osinika amandla okuqhubeka, amandla okuhleka kwakhona, amandla okukhumbula uBen ngaphandle kokuba intliziyo yethu yaphuke ngokupheleleyo.

Ryan, mfowethu omncane, uBen uyaqhubeka ekuthanda. Khumbula indlela uBen awayekuthanda ngayo, indlela awayekujonga ngayo njengomntu okhethekileyo. Ungalokothi uzive ungedwa. UBen uyaqhubeka ehamba nawe. Xa uziva usizi, khumbula ukuba uBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya. Uthando lwakhe aluzange luphele; lusaqhubeka lukhanya njengolwandle olukhulu. Uthando lwenu luyaqhubeka luhleli, lusaqhubeka lukhula, kwaye uBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya. Benjamin, lala ngokuthula. Uthando lwakho lulukhanya olungasoze lwavaleleka. Siya kukukhumbula njalo, side sidibane kwakhona apho kungekho nyembezi, apho kukho uvuyo olungunaphakade. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu Kristu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona ngenene kwiSakramente engcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwako konke, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Njengoko ngoku ndingenako ukukwamkela ngokwenyama, nceda uze emphefumlweni wam ngomoya. Ndiyakwamkela njengokuba sele ukhona, kwaye ndizimanyanisa ngokupheleleyo nawe. Ungaze uvumele ukuba ndahlukane nawe. Amen.
closing: Ngamana uThixo onamandla angasithamsanqelisa, asigcine, kwaye asikhokelele kuxolo lwakhe olungunaphakade. Hamba ngoxolo lweNkosi.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBenjamin Vo nabo bonke abaswelekileyo, ukuze baphumle ekukhanyeni kukaKristu ngonaphakade.
Sithandazela bonke abazali nabazalwana abasentlungwini, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele abanike ithemba elomeleleyo.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: O Galati abaziziyatha! Ngubani unikwe ubungqina obucacileyo bukaYesu Kristu obetshwe emnqamlezweni? Ndifuna ukufunda oku kuphela kuni: nifumene uMoya ngemisebenzi yomthetho, okanye ngokholo kwinto eniyivileyo? Nisaziziyatha nje? Emva kokuqala ngoMoya, ngoku niphela ngenyama? Ingaba nifumene izinto ezininzi ngelize?– ukuba kunjalo ngenene ngelize. Ngaba, ngoko, lowo unibonelela ngoMoya kwaye esenza imisebenzi emikhulu phakathi kwenu, wenza njalo ngemisebenzi yomthetho okanye ngokholo kwinto eniyivileyo?

readings.label: Indumiso
readings.text: Makabongwe uYehova, uThixo kaSirayeli; uze kubantu bakhe. Uvuse kithi umsindisi onamandla, ozalwe endlwini yomkhonzi wakhe uDavide. Makabongwe uYehova, uThixo kaSirayeli; uze kubantu bakhe. Ngabaprofeti bakhe abangcwele wathembisa kudala ukuba uya kusisindisa ezintshabeni zethu, nasezandleni zabo bonke abasithiyileyo. Makabongwe uYehova, uThixo kaSirayeli; uze kubantu bakhe. Wathembisa ukubonisa imfesane kooyise bethu nokukhumbula umnqophiso wakhe ongcwele. Makabongwe uYehova, uThixo kaSirayeli; uze kubantu bakhe. Esi yayisifungo awasifungayo koyise wethu uAbraham: ukusikhulula ezandleni zeentshaba zethu, sikhululeke ukumkhonza ngaphandle koloyiko, singcwele kwaye silungile phambi kwakhe yonke imihla yobomi bethu. Makabongwe uYehova, uThixo kaSirayeli; uze kubantu bakhe.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: UYesu wathi kubafundi bakhe: “Ngubani phakathi kwenu onomhlobo oya kuye phakathi kobusuku athi, ‘Mhlobo, ndiboleke izonka ezintathu, kuba umhlobo wam ufike endlwini yam evela kuhambo kwaye andinanto yakumnika yona,’ aze aphendule ephakathi esithi, ‘Musa ukundikhathaza; ucango sele lutshixiwe kwaye abantwana bam nam sele silele. Andinakuvuka ndikunike nto.’ Ndithi kuni, ukuba akavuki amnike izonka ngenxa yobuhlobo babo, uya kuvuka amnike nantoni na ayidingayo ngenxa yokunkqonkqoza kwakhe. Kwaye ndithi kuni, celani niya kufumana; funani niya kufumana; nkqonkqozani ucango luya kuvulelwa. Kuba wonke umntu ocelayo, uya kufumana; kwaye lowo ufunayo, uya kufumana; kwaye kulowo unkqonkqozayo, ucango luya kuvulelwa. Ngubani utata phakathi kwenu onganika unyana wakhe inyoka xa ecela intlanzi? Okanye anike unyana wakhe ufezela xa ecela iqanda? Ukuba ke nina, ninoogonyamela, niyazi ukunika izipho ezilungileyo kubantwana benu, hayi kakhulu uYise osezulwini uya kunika uMoya oyiNgcwele kulabo abacela kuye?”

day: Thursday of the Twenty-seventh Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben
